prompt: Many patients do not follow the advice they are given by their doctors. Why does this happen? What are the consequences of this behaviour?
essay:
It is a fact that a lot of patients do not follow what their doctor tell them. This is a big problem in many countries today. There are many reasons for this behaviour and it can bring serious consequences for the patient and for the health system.

One of the main reason is that the doctors do not have enough time. In the public hospitals a doctor sees maybe fifty patients in one day, so he only gives a prescription in five minutes and he does not explain why the medicine is necessary. If the patient does not understand the reason, he will stop to take the pills when he feels better. Another reason is the side effects. Some medicines make people feel tired or sick, so the patients decide by themselves to stop the treatment. Moreover, changing the life style is very hard. The doctor can say 'do more sport and eat less sugar', but this means the person must change all his habits, and this is not easy for the most of people.

The consequences are very bad. The illness can come back stronger and the patient must go to the hospital again, which costs a lot of money for the government. Also, if many patients do this, the waiting list becomes longer for everybody.

In conclusion, patients do not follow the medical advice because they do not understand it, because of the side effects and because it is difficult to change the habits, and this causes serious problems for everybody.
title: Why patients ignore their doctors
